questions.questionText: Which piece of equipment is useful in determining the density of an irregularly-shaped stone?

A child has four blocks of wood in the shapes of the letters A, M, T and X.
The blocks have equal heights and thicknesses. At their widest parts, their widths are equal.
The child stands the four blocks the right way up on a flat table.
Which block is most likely to fall over when the block is slightly knocked?

When an object falls freely due to gravity, energy that was stored as gravitational potential energy
is transferred to the kinetic energy store.
How is the energy transferred in this process?

A woman pushes a mower across a lawn.
Which quantities does the woman use to calculate the work she does?

A steel knife needs a cutting edge with a small surface area.
What is the reason for this?

options.text: A small surface area increases the pressure.
A small surface area increases the density of the steel.
A small surface area prevents the cutting edge from rusting.
A small surface area prevents the knife from becoming magnetised.

questions.questionText:
When a hot gas cools, its internal energy decreases.
What causes this?

options.text: a decrease in the average kinetic energy of the gas particles
a decrease in the gravitational potential energy of the gas particles
an increase in the average speed of the gas particles
an increase in the average distance of separation of the gas particles

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows part of a railway track.
Each section of the railway track is separated by a gap.
sections of
railway track
gap
Why are these gaps necessary?

options.text: The tracks contract on cold days.
The tracks contract on warm days.
The tracks expand on cold days.
The tracks expand on warm days.

questions.questionText:
A test-tube contains a volume of 1.0cm3 of liquid water at a temperature of 100°C. The liquid
water boils to form a volume of 1600cm3 of steam.
What is the reason for the large increase in volume?

options.text: Steam particles are bigger than water particles.
The average distance between the particles is much greater in the steam.
The particles do not move until the water turns into a gas.
There are more steam particles than there were water particles.

questions.questionText:
When a liquid is exposed to the air, the more-energetic particles escape from the surface of the
liquid.
What is the name of this process?

The diagram shows a hot-water tank. The tank has a heater, X, halfway up the tank.
hot water out
heater X
cold water in
Heater X is switched on.
Which row states the main processes by which thermal energy is transferred to the water above
the heater and to the water below the heater?
thermal energy transfer to thermal energy transfer to
the water above the heater the water below the heater

The handle of a metal cooking pan is made from wood.
What is a reason for making the handle from wood?

options.text: to increase thermal energy transfer by conduction
to increase thermal energy transfer by convection
to reduce thermal energy transfer by conduction
to reduce thermal energy transfer by convection

questions.questionText:
A student observes waves travelling across the surface of water. The diagram shows two pieces
of wood resting in shallow water of constant depth.
Straight parallel wavefronts approach the pieces of wood, as shown.
wavefront
wood gap wood
The gap between the pieces of wood is 2.0cm wide.
The wavefronts are 3.0cm apart.
What is the appearance of the wavefronts after they pass through the gap?

P-waves and S-waves are produced in the ground during an earthquake.
Which statement about these waves is correct?

options.text: Both P-waves and S-waves are longitudinal waves.
Both P-waves and S-waves are transverse waves.

questions.questionText:
A ray of light passes from air into a block of glass. The critical angle is 42°.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The angle of incidence is the angle between the ray of light and the surface of the glass block.
The angle of incidence is always bigger than 42°.
The angle of refraction cannot be less than 42°.
The angle of refraction is smaller than the angle of incidence.

questions.questionText:
White light can be split into different colours by passing it through a prism.
What is the name of this process?

A sound wave with a frequency of 25000Hz travels through air with a speed of 340m/s.
Why can a human not hear the sound?

A drummer hits a drum harder to make a louder sound without changing the pitch of the sound.
Which statement describes the change in properties of the sound as the drummer hits the drum
harder?

options.text: Only the amplitude of the sound increases.
Only the frequency of the sound decreases.
Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound increase.
Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound decrease.

questions.questionText:
Electromotive force (e.m.f.) is defined in terms of the energy supplied in driving which physical
quantity around a complete circuit?

A student measures the resistance of a wire.
Which two measurements must the student make?

The circuit symbol for an ammeter is a circle with a letter A in it. The symbol for a fuse is a
rectangle with a central line.
Which pair of circuit symbols is also one involving a circle followed by one involving a rectangle?
Which component is not needed when using an appliance that is double-insulated?
Which description of the structure of an atom is correct?

options.text: a negatively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it
a negatively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it
a positively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it
a positively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it

questions.questionText:
Four rocky planets orbit the Sun.
Which list shows these planets in order of increasing distance from the Sun?

In which given region of the electromagnetic spectrum does the Sun radiate the least of its
energy?

Light from distant galaxies is redshifted when it is observed from Earth.
Which property of the light increases when light is redshifted?
